LESSON: ADDITION

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Numbers
Topic 1.2: Addition

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Addition
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. add with and without regrouping

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Addition

Teach
• Align ones under ones, tens under tens.
• Add from the right.

Worked example
• 23 + 14 = 37
• 28 + 17 = 45 (regroup ones)
• KSh 45 + KSh 30 = KSh 75

Try this
• 46 + 12
• 39 + 28
• (Check later: 58; 67)


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• 23 + 14 = 37
• 28 + 17 = 45

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Solve five addition questions showing working.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a market addition word problem and solve it.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Add from the ones column first.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
